title: JEB A Very Grinchy Family Night
seo_title: A Very Grinchy Family Night at JEB in Lebanon, MO
description: JEB A Very Grinchy Family Night is a school family event with Grinchy learning and an interactive story at 4:15 PM in the Cafeteria, followed by a movie night at 6:00 PM in the gyms, with doors at 5:15 PM. The Main Gym shows a live version and the FEMA Gym shows the animated version; each person gets one free bag of popcorn, concessions are sold at regular prices, and guests are encouraged to bring blankets and chairs. It is for JEB families, and students may not attend without a parent or guardian. It takes place Thursday, December 3, 2026 at 16050 Highway KK in Lebanon, MO.
